login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to keep work flowing.
login.passkeyCancelled: You cancelled, or the prompt timed out.
login.passkeyFailed: That didn't work. Try again, or sign in another way.
login.passkeyRelaySubtitle: The app sent you here so this browser can ask for your passkey. You'll be sent straight back.
login.passkeyReturnToApp: You're signed in. Go back to the app — this tab can be closed.
login.defaultError: Unable to log in. Check your credentials.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: We will auto-approve your email if it matches the workspace allow list.
register.subtitleBootstrap: No users exist yet. This account will become the workspace super user.
register.captchaRequired: Please complete the captcha to continue.
register.inviteInvalid: Invite code is no longer valid.
register.defaultError: Unable to register. Try a different email.
register.verifyEmailMessage: Thanks! Check your inbox to verify your email before signing in.
register.pendingApproval: Thanks! Your account is pending approval from an administrator.
register.unableToLoadInvite: Unable to load invite details right now.
register.usernameHint: Your handle. People find you by this — a number is added to keep it unique.

usernameError.USERNAME_TOO_SHORT: A username needs at least 3 characters.
usernameError.USERNAME_TOO_LONG: A username can be at most 32 characters.
usernameError.USERNAME_INVALID_CHARACTERS: Use letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.
usernameError.USERNAME_MUST_START_WITH_LETTER: A username starts with a letter.
usernameError.USERNAME_UNAVAILABLE: That username has no numbers left. Try another.

register.recoveryCodesNote: Your account has no password, so these codes are how you set one later. Save them somewhere safe — they are shown once.
register.noDoorHere: This deployment does not take new accounts directly. Sign in with your organization's provider instead.

inviteRequired.title: Invite required
inviteRequired.subtitle: Public registration is not available. Please ask an existing member for an invite link to join.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email tied to your account. We'll send a reset link if it exists.
forgotPassword.sent: If that account exists, a reset link is on its way to your inbox.
forgotPassword.error: Unable to send reset email. Try again later.
forgotPassword.useRecoveryCode: No password to reset? Use a recovery code
forgotPassword.recoverSubtitle: Enter one of your recovery codes to set a password. You'll sign in with it afterwards.
forgotPassword.recovered: Your password is set. Sign in with it now.
forgotPassword.recoverError: Couldn't set a password. Check the address and the code, then try again.
forgotPassword.backToReset: Send me a reset link instead

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter and confirm your new password to continue.
resetPassword.subtitleInvalid: This link is invalid. Request a new one.
resetPassword.missingToken: Reset link is missing. Use the email link again.
resetPassword.error: Unable to reset password. The link may have expired.

verifyEmail.title: Email verification
verifyEmail.success: Email verified! You can sign in now.
verifyEmail.error: Verification link is invalid or expired.

oidcCallback.title: Signing you in…
oidcCallback.subtitle: Hold tight while we finish authenticating your account.

session.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

connectServer.title: Connect to Server
connectServer.subtitle: Enter the URL of your Initiative server to get started.
connectServer.serverUrlHelp: Enter the base URL of your Initiative server

guildLogin.title: Sign in
guildLogin.subtitle: Sign in to continue to this community.
guildLogin.noProviders: This community's sign-in isn't available. Check the link, or contact your community admin.
guildLogin.nativeUnsupported: Community sign-in isn't available in the app yet. Use a browser to sign in.

stepUp.title: Additional sign-in required
stepUp.description: This community requires signing in with {{providerName}} to access its content.

chooseHandle.title: Choose your username
chooseHandle.subtitle: Your account was given one automatically. Pick the name people will see — a number is added to keep it unique.
chooseHandle.error: That username could not be set. Try another.

confirmAge.title: How old are you?
confirmAge.subtitle: You're joining a community anyone signed in can find. Communities like that are open to people you have not met, so we ask your age once.
confirmAge.privacyNote: We use this to work out whether you are old enough, and then discard it. Your account records that you answered, never the date. It is not sold, shared, or kept.
confirmAge.scopeNote: Only joining a community anyone here can find asks this. The communities you were invited to never do, and nothing else on Initiative does.
confirmAge.required: Enter your date of birth to continue.
confirmAge.error: That could not be saved. Please try again.
confirmAge.blockedTitle: You told us you're not old enough yet
confirmAge.blockedBody: Communities anyone here can find need you to be 16 or older, so you can't join one for now. Everything in the communities you were invited to is unaffected.
confirmAge.blockedHelp: If you entered the wrong date, ask an administrator of this server to reset the question for you. We did not keep the date you gave.

secondFactor.title: One more step
secondFactor.subtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
secondFactor.recoverySubtitle: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved.

factorStepUp.title: One more step for this community
factorStepUp.description: This community asks everyone for a second factor. Enter the code from your authenticator app to carry on.
factorStepUp.recoveryDescription: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved.
factorStepUp.notEnrolled: This community asks everyone for a second factor, and this account doesn't have one yet. Set one up in your security settings, then come back.
factorStepUp.error: We couldn't add your authenticator to this session. Try again.
factorStepUp.passkeyTitle: One more step for this community
factorStepUp.passkeyDescription: This community asks everyone for a passkey. Present yours to carry on.
factorStepUp.passkeyNone: This community asks everyone for a passkey, and this account doesn't have one yet. Add one in your security settings, then come back.
factorStepUp.passkeyNative: This community asks for a passkey, which the app can't present. Open it in a browser instead.
factorStepUp.proofNative: This change needs a fresh sign-in, which the app can't do here. Open the site in a browser instead.
factorStepUp.passkeyError: We couldn't add your passkey to this session. Try again.
factorStepUp.proofDescription: This change needs a fresh sign-in. Present your passkey, then try again.
factorStepUp.proofSignIn: This change needs a fresh sign-in. Sign out and back in, then try again.
factorStepUp.platformDescription: This server requires a second factor. Enter a code from your authenticator app to carry on.
factorStepUp.platformNotEnrolled: This server requires a second factor and your account doesn't have one yet. Set one up to carry on — it takes about a minute.

emailOtp.title: Sign in with a code
emailOtp.subtitle: We'll email you a code to type in here.
emailOtp.captchaRequired: Please complete the captcha to continue.
emailOtp.codeSubtitle: We sent a code to {{email}}. It works for 10 minutes.
emailOtp.handleSubtitle: Your address is confirmed. Pick a name and you're in.
emailOtp.sendError: Could not send a code. Try again.
emailOtp.codeError: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
emailOtp.registerError: Could not create the account. Try again.
